name: Smith Farms Custom Furniture
old_description: "It was an absolute privilege to work with Smith Farms Custom Furniture. Matt had so many ideas and it was so much fun to bounce these ideas back and forth as we came up with solutions and made sure we both were always on the same page. And he's just an easy guy to talk with as well! You always get the sense that he can see what you're seeing and that's a really important quality. If you're seeking someone for a custom furniture piece, I definitely say that you're in the right place. No hesitation!"
about:
Smith Farms Custom Furniture operates from Murrieta, California, serving clients across Southern California including Temecula, Orange County, and San Diego County. The company was founded by Matt Smith, continuing a family tradition of woodworking craftsmanship. While the exact founding year is not publicly stated, the business emphasizes its heritage through the tagline "Continuing the Tradition."

The shop designs and builds custom furniture pieces such as dining tables, desks, chairs, beds, and occasional tables. Working primarily with premium hardwoods — including walnut, cherry, white oak, elm, ebo, and wenge — the team produces small-batch and one-off items. Recent projects highlighted on their site include the Willow Loft Bed, the Summer Olive Occasional Table, and the Wright Dining Table, each crafted from selected slabs and lumber.

Smith Farms serves residential clients directly, often collaborating with homeowners to tailor pieces to specific spaces and styles. A testimonial from a client in Fallbrook describes a collaborative design process where ideas are exchanged until the final solution matches the client's vision. The company's service area spans cities from Aliso Viejo to Valley Center, indicating a regional focus in Southern California.

The company differentiates itself through design recognition: its projects have earned awards from the New York Product Design Awards and the European Product Design Awards, including gold and silver honors for specific pieces. Features in Mountain Living Magazine, Western Design Conference, and other design publications underscore its reputation for award-winning custom furniture that blends functionality with aesthetics.
